name: audio-tools.setpoint-read
purpose: Read bounded engine, health, and selected experiment measurements without promoting diagnostic or replay evidence into voice acceptance.

experiment_id.description: Optional explicit experiment ID (ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, underscore; at most 128 characters). No automatic latest-run selection.

assumptions: Audio Tools and Program Runtime are running; reads may fail independently.
Current PRD targets remain authoritative; pilot numeric, corpus, and commercial decisions in TESTING.md and MONETIZATION.md are not approved bands.
Experiment metrics are diagnostic replay readings, not current browser latency, native-device qualification, or billing evidence.
Protojson omits some zero/default scalar fields; absent values remain unknown rather than being imputed as zero.
invariants: No audio, transcript, credential, raw provider error, inference request, or mutation appears in output or is initiated by this program.

Portable-voice-v1 target rows are resolved only by the owner-backed acceptance receipt join. Generic qualification evidence is never accepted merely because it exists; excluded rows remain explicitly excluded. Target text summarizes published scope, not approved numeric bands or billing details. Status ok only means collection succeeded.
Each binding failure is isolated and reported; no missing read becomes a zero or a passing band. Malformed, failed, and empty owner receipts remain visible as negative evidence.
Engine and health inventories use a sentinel above their bounds; oversized inventories are declined, never silently truncated into exact counts.
A selected experiment must match identity and have succeeded before exposing its bounded replay metrics; zero reference words, missing metrics, and nonfinite values are not quality evidence.
The program prints one standard JSON envelope on every path.

bindings.note: Owner-backed transcript-free qualification receipts; empty or failed receipts never qualify a row.
Only called for an explicit experiment_id; meta contains experiment and report, not run rows.

signals.acceptance: unknown until every required row is resolved by the owner-backed receipt join; excluded rows are explicit.
signals.rows: Fifteen {row,reading,target,in_band,unavailable,reason} outcome rows, one per published PRD target. Required readings contain the matching cohort/build and receipt references only after strict revision and negative-control checks. Existing nine row IDs are preserved and six are added; use row identity, not list position or a cached row count.
signals.diagnostics: At most three inventory rows, never banded as outcome proof.
signals.evidence_integrity: Owner receipt count, valid/failed/invalid counts, and a typed reason. Failed attempts remain visible and are excluded from acceptance joins; malformed or identity-invalid receipts fail the structural audit. A missing or retyped repeated evidence field is malformed, not empty telemetry. The raw evidence response is bounded at 512 rows.
signals.acceptance_join: Required-row count, resolved-row count, distinct receipt cohorts, bounded inspected-receipt count, and aggregate in_band verdict from current owner receipt claims. Failed target-aware artifacts remain negative evidence even when their payload contains an optimistic claim.
signals.unavailable: Count of unknown outcome and diagnostic rows.
signals.experiment: Selection presence and ID, status, finished_at, acceptance_eligible=false, and evidence limitation; never recipe transcripts.
signals.replay_metrics: At most 16 cells containing engine_id, strategy, lane, diagnostic verdict, ref_words, WER, RTF and replay finalization p95; absent/invalid readings are null.

outputs.evidence: Successful governed binding IDs; no private payloads.

fixtures.note: A live read, not an audio qualification or a zero-unavailable gate.
Reject before bindings; no filesystem selector or transcript input.
